title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Certificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.).
  • Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE.
  • Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão.
  • Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP.
  • Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you:

  • 5 years of experience in software engineering.
  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Company Overview:Lean Tech is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.
Position Title:  Mid+ Site Reliability EngineerLocation: Remote - LATAM
What you will be doing:We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our SaaS platform. This role is critical in improving incident response, system observability, and performance optimization, while proactively preventing disruptions.As part of the Cloud Operations organization, you will lead post-incident investigations, implement preventative strategies, and partner with Engineering and Observability teams to enhance system resilience. You will also play a key role in building automation, improving time-to-resolution (TTR), and enabling a data-driven approach to reliability.
Requirements & Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess:
  • Strong expertise in SRE practices, incident management, and production operations.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as:
    • New Relic
    • Datadog
    • Sumo Logic
    • or similar platforms
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting (e.g., JavaScript, .NET, SQL).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
    Experience troubleshooting C#/.NET web applications and performance issues.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with:
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Strong troubleshooting experience in:
    • Windows environments
    • SQL Server
  • Previous experience as a:
    • Software Engineer
    • System Administrator
Soft Skills:
  • Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Why you will love Lean Tech:
  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. 
Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.


You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.


This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You’ll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.


Some of your day-to-day will be:

  • Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using TypeScript and React.
  • Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
  • Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
  • Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles.


Requirements:

  • Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React).
  • Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
  • Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
  • Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
  • Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
  • Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn’t needed.


Benefits:

  • International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
  • Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

title: Customer Operations & Finance Support
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Operations & Finance Support professional to join our team and play a key role in managing premium enterprise customer accounts within a structured ITIL‑based operations model.


This role combines customer service leadership, finance & accounting ownership, and IT service management , making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across functions, engaging with senior stakeholders, and driving operational excellence in a multinational environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Create, update, and manage customer data within internal ITIL tools to support end‑to‑end service workflows
  • Own and manage the financial health of customer accounts , including:
  • Monthly Balance Sheet preparation & review
  • Account reconciliations
  • P&L analysis and variance explanations
  • Perform financial analysis and reporting to support business and management decisions
  • Lead customer onboarding and offboarding for SAP ECS accounts , coordinating with cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Work directly with Premium Customers , ensuring a high‑quality, reliable service experience
  • Monitor customer service metrics, analyze trends, and take proactive actions to improve delivery
  • Measure, track, and improve overall customer experience levels
  • Analyze support workflows and propose improvements for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage support operations in a 24x5 model , ensuring smooth workload handovers and SLA compliance
  • Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Support management with forecasting, budgeting , and performance tracking vs. plan
  • Lead and support customer service teams through transitions, service introductions, or operational changes
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to align customer service outcomes with company goals


✅ What You Bring


  • Experience working in an Operations Support model
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience in frontline customer management , including executive‑level interactions
  • Proven experience managing Finance & Accounting aspects of customer accounts
  • Hands‑on experience with ITIL processes , including:
  • Incident Management
  • Service Request Management
  • Change Management
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data analysis and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross‑cultural environment


Nice to Have


  • Project management experience in service transition and/or service introduction
  • Experience with common customer service and ITSM tools
  • Exposure to enterprise or SAP‑based customer environments


Please submit resumé in English

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [TECH LEAD - FULL STACK]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Atuar na implantação e evolução de projetos com Machine Learning , desde a concepção até o deploy em produção
  • Definir e sustentar arquiteturas modernas (cloud, microserviços, APIs, dados)
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de problemas complexos e tomada de decisão técnica
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções tecnológicas
  • Garantir governança técnica, observabilidade e performance das aplicações
  • Promover cultura de melhoria contínua, inovação e compartilhamento de conhecimento



Requisitos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) fullstack e/ou líder técnico(a)
  • Vivência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e cloud (AWS ou Azure)
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Node.js, React native, React.js, GraphQL, Nest.js
  • Experiência prática na implantação de soluções com Machine Learning em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e atuar de forma colaborativa com múltiplos stakeholders


Diferenciais


  • Experiência ou conhecimento no mercado de Trade Marketing (Varejo, execução em PDV, etc.)
  • Vivência com dados de campo, reconhecimento de imagem ou analytics aplicados a trade



CLT - Modelo remoto (ou híbrido para quem mora na região de Boituva/SP)

Seg a qui 08-18h (sexta 17h)



✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Data Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY


Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.


They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!


Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
  • Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
  • Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
  • Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
  • Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
  • Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
  • Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
  • Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required


EXPERIENCE


  • Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
  • 2 years experience creating and deploying custom PowerBI dashboards
  • Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
  • Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
  • Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
  • Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports


QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


  • Business/B2+ Level English
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • High level of numeracy and attention to detail
  • Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
  • Strong PowerBI (PowerQuery, M, DAX)
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • Python Scripting skills (Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
  • PowerShell scripting (desirable)
  • SQL skills (desirable)
  • Developer skills (desirable)
  • Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
  • Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
  • Good PowerPoint and presentation skills
  • Experience working with IT systems and related projects (desirable)
  • Motivated self-starter
  • Personable and professional manner


Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. They welcome applications from people with backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in tech and truly believe diversity is the key to creativity and innovation.

title: Technical Support Analyst (SAP ATLAS)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‑oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‑to‑end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.

Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core

  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.


To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent mindset while enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value candidates with full software lifecycle experience, encompassing requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing support.


Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry
  • Strong passion for backend architecture and application development, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Building and optimizing high-load, high-performance, data-driven backend systems
  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++



Resumo do Propósito da Função:

Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.

Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).

O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.



Esta função envolve:

  • Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.
  • Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas.
  • Manutenção de pipelines.
  • Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.



RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países.
  • Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Desenvolver novos serviços.
  • Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters.
  • Manter a tecnologia atual.




REQUISITOS:


Essencial:

  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes
  • Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.
  • Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.



Desejável:

  • Javascript
  • Kubernetes
  • AKS
  • Terraform
  • Monitoring systems
  • Prometheus Stack
  • Messaging (RabbitMQ)




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams
  • Ability to navigates ambiguity with grace
  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic environment, with the agility to adjust to evolving guidelines and requirements

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – Integrations (Ruby / JavaScript)

Remote (US)

We’re working with a mission-driven healthcare technology company focused on improving how patient data flows across systems to drive better outcomes at scale. Their platform supports millions of patients and is built around interoperability, data, and real-world impact.

They’re looking for a Software Engineer to join their Integrations team, building and maintaining connections between external systems and their core platform.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and maintain backend integrations across APIs, databases, and external systems
  • Work on data flows, ETL processes, and system-to-system integrations
  • Develop and support integration workflows using tools like Rhapsody / Mirth (or similar integration engines)
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions
  • Contribute to integration architecture and platform connectivity

What they’re looking for:

  • Experience with Ruby / Ruby on Rails
  • Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience
  • Background in backend systems, integrations, and distributed systems
  • Experience with APIs (REST), ETL, middleware, or event-driven architecture
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Solid understanding of databases (Postgres / SQL)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with integration engines (Rhapsody, Mirth, or similar)
  • Exposure to healthcare interoperability (FHIR, HL7, EHR/EMR systems)
  • Experience working with messaging platforms or communication APIs
  • Experience in data-heavy or highly regulated environments

Fully remote (US) | Competitive hourly rate | 12-month contract (likely to extend)

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico.


Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:
  • Geneos ITRS
  • EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)
  • Market Data API
  • AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Fiscal Pleno para integrar nosso time e atuar diretamente com clientes em rotinas fiscais e iniciativas ligadas à Reforma Tributária.


Responsabilidades:

  • Acompanhar apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos;
  • Apoiar nas obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, entre outras);
  • Realizar análise, conferência e validação de notas fiscais;
  • Apoiar conciliações fiscais de média/alta complexidade;
  • Participar de iniciativas e projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária;
  • Interagir diretamente com clientes, apoiando demandas e entregas;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos e eficiência operacional;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com rotinas fiscais e apuração de tributos;
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias (SPED, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, PER/DCOMP);
  • Experiência com conciliações fiscais;
  • Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCV/XLOOKUP, fórmulas);
  • Conhecimento em SAP e/ou Guepardo será um diferencial;
  • Interesse ou conhecimento em Reforma Tributária;
  • Ensino Superior Completo;


Perfil:

  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para lidar com feedbacks;
  • Interesse em aprendizado contínuo;
  • Inteligência emocional para atuar com clientes;

title: Desenvolvedor Cobol Mainframe
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar com desenvolvimento e manutenção em ambientes mainframe, lidando com sistemas críticos e alta volumetria...

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol com experiência em DB2 e forte atuação em ajustes estruturais e evolução de sistemas...

Se você domina Cobol, SQL e análise de impacto em sistemas legados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar alterações em tabelas DB2 para adequação ao formato de CNPJ alfanumérico
  • Analisar impactos e ajustar programas Cobol existentes
  • Atuar na manutenção e atualização de artefatos como Books e Sysins
  • Desenvolver e ajustar rotinas e procedimentos em SQL / Proc SQL
  • Apoiar testes técnicos, validações e homologações
  • Acompanhar processos de implantação em produção
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados durante as alterações
  • Identificar riscos e impactos em sistemas legados
  • Atuar na correção de incidentes e melhorias evolutivas
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e áreas envolvidas no projeto


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência como Desenvolvedor Cobol em ambiente Mainframe
  • Conhecimento sólido em DB2
  • Experiência com SQL e Proc SQL
  • Vivência em manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados
  • Experiência com análise de impacto e ajustes em programas Cobol
  • Conhecimento em manipulação de tabelas e dados em ambientes críticos
  • Experiência com testes, validação e implantação de sistemas
  • Boa comunicação e atenção a detalhes
  • Perfil proativo, confiável e com senso de responsabilidade


Diferencial

  • Experiência em projetos de CNPJ alfanumérico
  • Vivência anterior no Banco Safra
  • Certificação em linguagem Cobol ou tecnologias correlatas
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em ambientes financeiros/bancários
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e sistemas críticos


Formato de trabalho

  • 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - DBT GCP
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end SR
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Java com Experiência em AWS e Camunda - SR


Modalidade: remoto


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Backend talentoso e apaixonado para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com foco em Java, e conhecimento em serviços de nuvem AWS e na ferramenta de gerenciamento de processos de negócios Camunda.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java.

- Projetar, implementar e gerenciar processos de negócios utilizando Camunda.

- Integrar soluções em nuvem utilizando os serviços da AWS.

- Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e entregar novas funcionalidades.

- Realizar testes e garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.

- Participar de revisões de código e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java.

- Familiaridade com AWS e serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, entre outros.

- Conhecimento em Camunda BPM e sua implementação em projetos.

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais (SQL, NoSQL).

- Compreensão de práticas de DevOps e CI/CD.

- Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação.

- Desejo de aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Conhecimento em outras linguagens de programação como Python ou JavaScript.

- Certificações em AWS ou Camunda.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Web
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨


Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.


Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Buscamos por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack com experiência sólida em JavaScript/TypeScript para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e escalabilidade que suportam os nossos produtos de PDV, Totem de autoatendimento e Portal de Gestão. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções modernas utilizando React no front-end e Node.js no back-end, integrando serviços em nuvem AWS e garantindo qualidade em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando React no front-end.
  • Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços com Node.js e frameworks como Fastify, Express, NestJS e Koa.js .
  • Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ERPs, adquirentes, gateways de pagamento).
  • Modelar e gerenciar bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ).
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD em BitBucket e GitLab .
  • Trabalhar com infraestrutura em AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, entre outros).
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e revisão de código.
  • Colaborar com times de mobile e produto para garantir coesão entre as camadas
  • Monitorar aplicações e serviços utilizando CloudWatch e ferramentas correlatas.
  • Garantir versionamento e boas práticas de colaboração com Git .
  • Apoiar processos de deploy, rollout e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança nas entregas.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência comprovada em JavaScript/TypeScript . Conhecimento avançado em React e Node.js .
  • Vivência com frameworks back-end (Fastify, Express, NestJS, Koa.js ).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas como BitBucket/GitLab .
  • Experiência com AWS e seus principais serviços.
  • Domínio de Git para versionamento e colaboração.


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Vivência com integrações com sistemas externos (ex: adquirentes, ERPs, gateways de pagamento)
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de segurança e observabilidade em APIs REST (rate limiting, circuit breaker, tracing, etc.)
  • Participação em projetos com alto volume transacional e requisitos de alta disponibilidade


Stack e Ferramentas

  • Linguagem: JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript
  • Front-end: React (SPA, Hooks, Context API, boas práticas de componentização)
  • Runtime: Node.js
  • Frameworks: Fastfy, Express, NestJS, Koa.js
  • Banco de dados: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • CI/CD: BitBucket, GitLab
  • Infraestrutura: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, etc.)
  • Monitoramento: CloudWatch, etc.
  • Versionamento: Git
  • Boas Práticas: Clean Code, SOLID, testes automatizados, integração contínua e cultura DevOps


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em produtos críticos com desafios reais de performance e escalabilidade
  • Ambiente técnico colaborativo e com autonomia para decisões arquiteturais
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho remoto ou híbrido
  • Acesso a produtos reais com grande volume de transações


Mais informações:

  • Possuir CNPJ ativo (nosso modelo de contratação é PJ - Prestador de Serviço);
  • Vagas remota e com horários flexíveis;
  • Temos 2 vagas (uma nível PL e outra SR).


Acha que é essa vaga é pra você? Não perca tempo e venha fazer parte da revolução do varejo com a gente! #vemsereyemaker!

title: Mean Stack Developer
description:
MEAN Stack Developer


On a day-to-day basis you will be:

  • Understanding logical architectures for web applications using better practice design principles.
  • Leading the development of web applications with the support of a small development team (for lead roles).
  • Utilizing CI/CD workflows using build and release automation in Azure DevOps.
  • Application development based on screens, documented requirements, and user stories
  • Assisting with third level support by driving the resolution of application defects and supporting a response to major application incidents.
  • Coaching other developers and sharing your knowledge and expertise within the team.
  • Participating in firmwide software development forums and communities to share ideas and contribute to our body of knowledge.
  • Actively participating in daily team stand-ups, workshops, and online technical forums.




About you


Applicants must be able to demonstrate the following ke

y capabilities and behaviour:

  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills, an analytical mindset and outstanding attention to detail.
  • Experience designing and developing javascript web applications using Node.Js, Angular 2+, CSS3, HTML5 and Javascript.
  • Experience developing middleware, integration and messaging systems using REST APIs and popular message bus platforms (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).
  • Strong understanding of event-driven, asynchronous programming concepts and best practice application design principles.
  • Strong understanding of non-relational database design and querying by using MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis or other.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment, ideally using Azure DevOps (formerly Visual Studio Team Services).
  • Ability to work efficiently with remote teams using collaboration technology.
  • Ability to identify issues and solve complex problems as part of a team.
  • Ability to lead small development teams and foster strong working relationships (only for leads).
  • Ability to remain calm when under pressure and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to resolving problems.


Ideally, you will also have:

  • Knowledge of ORM/ODM like Sequelize and Mongoose.
  • Experience with microservices architectures and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience designing, developing and automating unit tests.
  • Strong understanding of source code version control, including the use of Git repositories.
  • Experience working on projects that follow an Agile Scrum methodology.
  • Strong awareness of system development life cycles (SDLC).
  • Good understanding of relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or any other.

title: Content Moderator
description:
We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network , and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.

If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.


Job Title: Content Reviewer

Location: Remote /Brazil

Type: Freelance

Required Engagement: 30 hours per week



Key Responsibilities:

• Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy

• Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations

• Follow project guidelines while reviewing content

• Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content

• Categorize and tag content appropriately


Key Requirements:

• Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events

• Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization

• Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills


Assessment Process:

Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:

• LLM Evaluation Assessment

• Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

title: Content Moderator
description:
We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network , and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.

If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.


Job Title: Content Reviewer

Location: Remote /Brazil

Type: Freelance

Required Engagement: 30 hours per week



Key Responsibilities:

• Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy

• Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations

• Follow project guidelines while reviewing content

• Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content

• Categorize and tag content appropriately


Key Requirements:

• Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events

• Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization

• Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills


Assessment Process:

Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:

• LLM Evaluation Assessment

• Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

title: SAP Basis Upgrades SUM and Conversion specialist
description:
We are seeking skilled SAP Basis Experts to execute complex SAP system upgrades and conversions, The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SAP Basis, a strong understanding of SAP architecture, and hands-on experience with SAP system conversions, upgrades, copies and migrations .

  • Key Responsibilities: 7+ years of Basis Experience
  • Plan and execute SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) across development, quality, and production environments.
  • Lead SAP S/4HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation.
  • Utilize tools such as SUM (Software Update Manager) , Maintenance Planner , DMO (Database Migration Option) , and SPAM/SAINT .
  • Experience in Update, System copies and Client copies
  • Perform OS/DB migrations , Unicode conversions, and HANA database upgrades.
  • Conduct mock conversions , dry runs, and cutover planning for production migrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and readiness for upgrades and conversions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during and post-upgrade/conversion.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of upgrade/conversion procedures and lessons learned.
  • Stay current with SAP’s roadmap, release strategy, and best practices for upgrades and conversions.
  • ECS experience is added advantage

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a fast-paced, customer-centric team focused on delivering personalized digital experiences at scale. In this role, you will contribute to the development of full-stack solutions that power marketing and personalization initiatives across web platforms. You will work within a modern MarTech ecosystem, helping to build and maintain customer-facing features, support data-driven experiences, and ensure the reliability of high-traffic user journeys.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain customer-facing features using React, Next.js, and Java/Spring Boot.
  • MarTech Integration: Support the integration of Customer Data Platforms (CDP) and other marketing technologies.
  • Work with event-driven architectures, including message publishing, data pipelines, and event consumption.
  • Contribute to solutions that enable targeting and personalized customer experiences.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions, working closely with product and engineering teams.
  • Develop reliable, scalable systems that support high-volume traffic and transactions.
  • Contribute to micro-frontend SPA architectures and composable web platforms (e.g., Netlify, Vercel).
  • Ensure maintainable, well-tested code aligned with engineering best practices.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with backend development using Java/Spring Boot.
  • Understanding of API development and system integrations.
  • Foundational knowledge of event-driven systems, message queues, and data pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to adapt in fast-paced environments.
  • Understanding of digital product development and user experience principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Familiarity with MarTech concepts, including content management, targeting, and personalization.
  • Experience with CMS platforms such as Contentful.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) such as Segment.io.
  • Exposure to personalization tools and strategies.
  • Experience working with event pipelines, serverless functions, or data streaming systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS), CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins), and containerization (Kubernetes).
  • Experience in subscription-based or e-commerce platforms.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer | Data Science
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.


Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.


Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.


No dia a dia você vai:

  • Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
  • Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
  • Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
  • Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
  • Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
  • Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos


E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
  • Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT


Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:


No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.


Benefícios:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;
  • Auxílio alimentação;
  • Aconselhamento financeiro;
  • Clube de vantagens;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Auxílio Mobilidade;
  • Auxílio Criança;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licenças estendidas;
  • Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
  • Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer | Data Science
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.


Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.


Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.


No dia a dia você vai:

  • Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
  • Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
  • Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
  • Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
  • Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
  • Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos


E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
  • Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT
